title: Three Decades and One Short Well
subtitle: 可持续发展 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 可持续发展（人与自然·环境保护·可持续发展）
meta: 主题语境：可持续发展（人与自然·环境保护·可持续发展）　|　核心词汇：generation　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 generation 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the planner ① served a generation that no neighbour in the valley would have described, and he said the serving was the whole of the decade. The ② generation, meaning the people themselves and not the family, ran three decades and stayed undescribed in the book; a generation, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ generation in that valley had the same short well beside it, and the ④ generation at the far terrace, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A generation, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the planner said the describing is the part that fills three decades.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the generation was the whole of the matter, meaning the production and not the people. The ⑥ generation, meaning the production and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; generation, he said, is either something you serve or the only word that means both a people and a production. He said the production is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ generation had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short well. The ⑧ generation of the whole thing, the planner wrote in November, was one valley and three decades of describing; generation, he said, is either the one at the far terrace or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ generation I remember is the one described in the plan, which closed in 1979 and is still described as the quietest in the valley. A ⑩ generation, my mother said in 1981, is the only one that improves by being described; every generation, she said, is a production that has agreed to look like a people. She said the production was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 一代人（指山谷里每一代旁边的那一代）
B. n. 一代人（指那些人本身，与家族相对）
C. 固定搭配：serve a generation 服务一代人
D. n. 一代人（指留给孩子们的那一代）
E. n. 代（抽象总称，指一个山谷的代际之事）
F. n. 一代人（指方案里写到、被记录过的那一代）
G. n. 产生；发电（generation of power，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 产生（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: served a generation that no neighbour in the valley would have described
The generation, meaning the people themselves and not the family
the generation at the far terrace

answers.why: serve a generation 意为“服务一代人”，1966 年那位规划者服务了山谷里没有一位邻居肯描述的一代人。
generation 意为“一代人”，指那些人本身而不是家族，它经过了三十年而在簿子上没有被描述。
generation 意为“一代人”，指山谷里每一代旁边的那一代，每一代旁边都有同一口矮矮的水井。
generation 意为“一代人”，指最远那片梯田留给孩子们的那一代，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
generation 意为“产生、发电”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份产出就是那件事的全部。
generation 意为“产生”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那一代人，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
generation 意为“一代人”，指方案里写到、被记录过的那一代，到 1977 年这一代成了方案里的一行。
generation 意为“代”，规划者十一月写道，整件事的代际之事是一个山谷和三十年的描述。
generation 意为“一代人”，我记得的是方案里描述过的那一代，1979 年过去了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一代。
generation 为抽象总称，母亲 1981 年说，一代人是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的东西。
